layouts.guidance: Demonstrate a safe traversal along the top-edge corridor while avoiding FIRE tiles, starting near the top-left region and aiming for the goal placed on or near the top edge, with a focus on recognizing and bypassing fire placements.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces fire-avoidance strategies when constrained to the top-edge corridor, emphasizing preemptive path planning and turning strategies near walls to bypass fire hazards.
layouts.rationale: This layout exercises top-edge traversal with three distinct fire placements to force the agent to plan ahead and avoid FIRE while moving along the top edge toward the goal.
